title: Dinotopia original coming up in October auction
content: Coming up atHeritage Auction'sOctober 15, 2019 Illustration Art Signature Auction(Dallas #5417)is an original of mine fromDinotopia: A Land Apart from Time,1992.The title is "Bix Leapt Down from Her Perch," Oil and pencil on board 6 x 7.25 in., framed under glass with calligraphy excerpt to 19 x 31 inches. Signed lower center. A copy of the book accompanies this lot.-----More original art news at my other blog,James Gurney Original Art.(Link to Heritage Auction)
